clips.title: The story
paras: The Binding is the culminating rite for Forsaken warlocks seeking to command a voidwalker. In the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, Carendin Halgar requires initiates to summon, conquer, and permanently subjugate a creature of the Void.

Unlike minor imps, which are easily coerced into pacts with dark magic, creatures of the Void despise reality and possess formidable physical might. To earn the right to summon a voidwalker, an aspiring warlock in the Undercity must prove total mastery over it. In the shadowed enclave of the Magic Quarter, the Forsaken mentor Carendin Halgar provides the mystic runes required to tear a voidwalker from the Nether into the physical realm.

The ritual takes place within the glowing summoning circle etched beneath the mentor's dais. Once the runes are activated, an unbound voidwalker materializes in fury. Subduing it is not an exercise in diplomacy; the summoner must break the entity through sheer arcane force and raw will. Only when the entity is thoroughly crushed does Carendin reveal the true formula of summoning, binding the creature's essence to the practitioner indefinitely.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Surely you have seen the circle of summoning below us? Only there will you be able to draw forth an unbound voidwalker.
Using these runes, you will be able to draw it forth, and then you must dominate it through strength of arms and magic.
When it is subdued, it will be indentured to you. Come to me then, and I will elucidate the spell of summoning, so that it may serve you to whatever end you wish.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I expect to hear of your success, friend. Not meeting my expectations will be the least of your worries, however, should you fail.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well, friend. Now, I will impart to you the spell used for summoning the voidwalker.
The power that it unleashed upon you is now yours to command. Use it wisely.
